title: Download Entra Policy Suite 2.1 and start the install
purpose: Downloads Entra Policy Suite 2.1 and runs its Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1 with your parameters. The Pro copy (invardia.com/support/eps/) signs you in in your browser, takes the signed Pro package of your ring from Invardia and checks its signature, size and SHA-256; the Community copy takes the latest v2 release from GitHub and checks it against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes. Either way the package is unpacked in a new temporary folder.
whenToRun: To install Entra Policy Suite 2.1, or to resume an install that stopped.

runAs.name: the rights Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1 needs
runAs.why: this script only downloads and starts it

changes.object: a temporary folder with the release zip and its contents
changes.why: the installer runs from the release
changes.undo: delete the eps-release-* folder in the temp directory

parameters.name: ConnectToInvardia
parameters.help: passed to the installer: Community only - yes connects this install to Invardia (health reports + updates on request), no keeps it anonymous; empty = asked once (default no)

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: passed to the installer (an install made before 2.0.55: rg-entrapolicysuite, found by itself when it is there)

parameters.name: (every other parameter of Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1)
parameters.help: passed on as given - e.g. -PrivateNetwork -VnetId -HubVnetId for a private install (tools/setup/install-parameters.json lists them)

parameters.name: SupportAppId
parameters.help: your Invardia Support app, by its client id (never found by name): it starts with -SupportAccess until your level from the Invardia portal arrives; without it nothing is granted

parameters.name: SupportAccess
parameters.help: the Support app's starting level: troubleshoot or setup (read, plus admin only during an open support session), read, or none

parameters.name: Resume
parameters.help: continue an interrupted install with the same values (finished steps are skipped); refused when there is none

whatIf: Downloads and checks the release, then runs the installer with -WhatIf (its plan; nothing is changed in Azure).
undo: Nothing to undo here; see Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1.
